name: Great Zimbabwe
story: A ruined city that served as the capital of the Kingdom of Zimbabwe during the country's Late Iron Age. It's a testament to the powerful and prosperous Shona civilization that existed from the 11th to 15th centuries.
didYouKnow: The stone walls of the Great Enclosure were built without mortar and are still standing today.

etiquetteTips.tip: Cover shoulders and knees near the sacred enclosure.
Allowed — but always ask before photographing people.
Do not climb on the ancient walls.
Greet elders first — a smile carries far.

localVoice.name: Tendai
localVoice.quote: Come at sunrise. Sit on the eastern wall and listen — you'll hear the wind carry the same songs the ancestors knew.
